detail.longDescription: A table can show RLS enabled and still hand every row to every signed-in user. That happens when the policy is only "authenticated can select", with no owner or tenant check. Login is not the same as owning the row. How to find tables like that, and the SQL to tighten them: https:// abbilabs.xyz/guides/supabase-r ls-check # Supabase # PostgreSQL # AppSec # vibecoding # AI # webdev # indiehackers # SaaS # devtools
